title: People ledger near the top of the readout
hypothesis: Listing every live object on the map right under Position, with when the model last talked to it (turns and story milestones since) and the story characters character presence names, gets models back to people whose lines changed after a story milestone (run qwen36-gpu1_show entered May's house at turn 418, took NINJA_BOY for MAY and never re-talked to May's mom, last spoken to at turn 145, before the starter), so more runs reach ROUTE_103 after the handoff in fewer turns.
notes: Uses the finals incumbent with dialogue-auto-advance-v1 ON, because people-ledger-v1 needs it (its page records are the talk history) and the finals incumbent has it off; the candidate flips only people-ledger-v1. Activation: the block is printed on every started overworld readout, the truck included, so the earliest point it changes what the model sees is PLAYER_NAME_CONFIRMED; the failure it targets is after BIRCH_STARTER_HANDOFF_COMPLETE (May's mom's ROUTE 103 line is gated on FLAG_SYS_POKEMON_GET), so a design that measures it should start from a post-handoff checkpoint and grade on ROUTE_103 rather than RIVAL_HOUSE_ENTERED. Approved by the operator 2026-10-16 as a bundle switch (option 1); the bundle definition is owned by the readiness thread. Provisional source.commit is the branch head before merge; repinned to the merge SHA with `just experiment-pin` when it lands.
